# Balance mod: the game's file, copied whole, with only the colony window's

# Generated by write_building_locks.py -- rerun it after every game update.
lacquerware_guild = {
	allow = { balance_building_not_forbidden = { TYPE = lacquerware_guild } }	# Balance mod: colony window build priorities
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = burghers
	max_levels = guild_max_level
	startup_ramp_target = guild_startup_ramp_target
	
	category = consumer_goods_category
	
	employment_size = guild_employment
	
	
	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes

	
	

	build_time = guild_build_time

	unique_production_methods = {
		lacquerware_shop_maintenance = {
			lumber = 1.2017
			dyes = 0.5007
			tools = 0.1204
			
			produced = lacquerware
			output = 1.0
			
			category = guild_input
			debug_max_profit = guild_profit_margin
		}
	}

	custom_tags = { guild }
	construction_demand = guild_construction
	can_destroy = { balance_building_not_kept = yes  # Balance mod: colony window building lock
	}
}
